title: Mouse Ears
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Mouse Ears |image = Mouse Ears.png |achievement = Best Friends |ad = Reach a 10-heart [[Friendship|friend]] level with someone. |price = {{Price|2000}} }} '''Mouse Ears''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|2000}} after earning the "Best Friends" [[Achievements|Achievement]] (reach a 10-heart [[Friendship|friend]] level with someone). The hat can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. There is a ≈2% chance to receive the gender-neutral outfit with the Mouse Ears. ==Notes== * The Mouse Ears outfit also includes a [[File:Shirt066.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Shirt]] and [[File:Shorts.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Shorts]] (dyed RGB value 183,163,163). ==References== Male players have 47 possible outfits (1/47 ≈ 2.13%), while female players have 48 possible ones (1/48 ≈ 2.08%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb. [[wikipedia:RGB color model|RGB]] refers to "Red,Green,Blue". ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.6|Purchase price increased from {{Price|1000}} to {{Price|2000}}.
